name: Sugar No. 11
read: Sugar No. 11 Mar 27 options (on MAR 27 futures 18.48, 97 days to expiry 2027-02-16): at-the-money implied vol 26.3%, -0.1 pts vs 2026-11-05. 20-day realized vol 28.6%, so options trade at a discount of 2.3 pts. 25-delta risk reversal +5.2 (calls over puts). Over the last 10 sessions (2026-10-29 to 2026-11-11) call open interest rose 39,197 and puts rose 20,171; put/call OI 0.52 → 0.52, front futures 19.47 → 18.48. Delta-weighted, option holders added about +7,370 futures-equivalent lots in the last 5 sessions (net long exposure bought through options). Front ATM vol 26.1% → 25.4%. Largest Mar 27 strikes: 20 calls (26,002 lots) and 17 puts (17,907). Biggest 5-session builds: Mar 27 20 calls +3,653; May 27 22 calls +2,171. Biggest cut: May 27 20 calls -2,354.
